items.d: Entry filing, HTS classification, PGA messaging, and liquidation tracking — the brokerage desk, modernized.
Every container and airwaybill tracked across carriers with milestone alerts and exception workflows.
Denied-party screening, admissibility rules, and audit-ready records for every transaction.
Commercial invoices, packing lists, and certificates parsed by AI and pinned to the right entry.
Your SKU catalog with HTS, duty rates, and PGA flags maintained in one place.
Supplier profiles, documentation status, and performance scoring across your vendor base.
Drayage, trucking, and warehousing coordinated with your customs timeline — no more demurrage surprises.
Landed cost, duty payables, and cash-flow timing for every shipment — finance finally speaks freight.
Ask about any shipment, entry, or regulation in plain language and get a sourced answer in seconds.

cta.sub: Bring one lane, one product, one headache — we'll show you what NIEL COS does with it.
cta.title: See the platform on your freight.

features.d: Every shipment carries one GTTID from PO to proof of delivery. Trace any carton, entry, or invoice to its origin in seconds — no more hunting across systems.
Machine-suggested HTS codes with confidence scoring, plus duty-rate analysis that finds legal savings before you file — not after you overpay.
PGA requirements, admissibility checks, and document validation run continuously against every entry. Exceptions arrive with a fix, not just a flag.
Ocean, air, and drayage milestones stream into one live map. At-risk shipments escalate automatically with owner, impact, and next action.
Duty, freight, warehousing, and fees roll into true landed cost per SKU. Pay vendors, manage cash flow, and forecast with trade-accurate numbers.
Connect your ERP, WMS, or forwarder via API and EDI. NIEL COS meets your stack where it lives — no rip-and-replace required.

hero.sub: NIEL COS is built on a Trade-to-Cash spine: every order, shipment, entry, and payment linked by a single Global Trade Transaction ID — from purchase order to final delivery.

integration.sub: API-first design with EDI support. Your ERP stays; your spreadsheets retire.
